q: God gave the Ten Commandments to Prophet ____ on Mount Sinai. (P3)
explain: Moses received the tablets of the Law on Mount Sinai.
hint: Prophet who received the Ten Commandments.

q: The fifth commandment teaches children to: '____ your father and mother.' (P3)
explain: Exodus 20:12: 'Honor your father and your mother that your days may be long.'

q: The young shepherd boy who defeated the giant Goliath with a sling and stone was ____. (P3)
explain: David trusted God and struck down the Philistine champion Goliath.

q: The prophet who was thrown into a den of hungry lions but protected by God was ____. (P3)
explain: Daniel's steadfast prayer life led God to shut the lions' mouths.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Genesis?
options: the first book of the Holy Bible containing creation accounts
explain: Genesis is the first book of the Holy Bible containing creation accounts.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Revelation?
options: the final apocalyptic book of the New Testament
explain: Revelation is the final apocalyptic book of the New Testament.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Psalms?
options: a collection of sacred songs, prayers, and hymns largely by King David
explain: Psalms is a collection of sacred songs, prayers, and hymns largely by King David.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John?
options: the four canonical Gospel accounts of the life and ministry of Jesus
explain: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John is the four canonical Gospel accounts of the life and ministry of Jesus.
hint: Description of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is The Ark of the Covenant?
options: a sacred gold-covered chest housing the Ten Commandments
explain: The Ark of the Covenant is a sacred gold-covered chest housing the Ten Commandments.
hint: Description of The Ark of the Covenant.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Noah?
options: the righteous man who built the Ark to preserve life during the Great Flood
explain: Noah is the righteous man who built the Ark to preserve life during the Great Flood.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P3): What is Abraham?
options: the founding Patriarch whom God promised to make the father of many nations
explain: Abraham is the founding Patriarch whom God promised to make the father of many nations.
